legislation.value: Corporation Tax Act, Part II Chapter II (IIR: 各対象会計年度の国際最低課税額に対する法人税; UTPR: 国際最低課税残余額に対する法人税; QDMTT: 国内最低課税額に対する法人税), plus the Local Corporation Tax Act
legislation.note: Statute references as listed in the OECD Central Record. UTPR name per the MOF FY2025 reform outline.

enactment.value: IIR: Act No. 3 of 2023 (promulgated March 2023), from FYs beginning on or after 1 April 2024. UTPR and QDMTT: FY2025 tax reform, from FYs beginning on or after 1 April 2026.
enactment.note: IIR enactment per the NTA GIR completion guide (June 2026 rev.). UTPR/QDMTT timing per the MOF FY2025 outline: https://www.mof.go.jp/tax_policy/tax_reform/outline/fy2025/07taikou_05.htm

headlineCitRate.value: National corporation tax 23.2% (large ordinary corporations). Combined national + local effective rate 29.74%, or 30.64% where the Defense Special Corporate Tax (from April 2026) applies.

domesticTopUpTax.localName: 各対象会計年度の国内最低課税額に対する法人税 (Japanese QDMTT)
domesticTopUpTax.value: Domestic minimum top-up tax on Japanese constituent entities. Introduced by the FY2025 reform for FYs beginning on or after 1 April 2026.

QDMTT.localName: 国内最低課税額に対する法人税
QDMTT.value: Fiscal years (対象会計年度) beginning on or after 1 April 2026

IIR.localName: 国際最低課税額に対する法人税
IIR.value: Fiscal years beginning on or after 1 April 2024

UTPR.localName: 国際最低課税残余額に対する法人税
UTPR.value: Fiscal years beginning on or after 1 April 2026

QDMTTSafeHarbour.value: QDMTT Safe Harbour: Yes, from 1 April 2026

filing.obligation: GIR (特定多国籍企業グループ等報告事項等) via e-Tax
filing.who: Japanese constituent entity (one may file as representative)
filing.value: Within 1 year 3 months from the day after FYE (1 year 6 months for the first filing). If that falls before 30 June 2026, the deadline is 30 June 2026. Deadlines on weekends/holidays roll to the next business day.

filing.obligation: IIR return (国際最低課税額に対する法人税等の申告), only if there is a taxable amount
filing.value: Within 1 year 3 months from the day after FYE (1 year 6 months in the first case). Floor of 30 June 2026. Corporations with capital over ¥100m must file electronically.

filing.obligation: QDMTT information return (グループ国内最低課税額報告事項等) via e-Tax
filing.who: Japanese constituent entities / JVs (exempt if received via exchange from the UPE / designated filer jurisdiction)
filing.value: Within 1 year 3 months from the day after FYE ('1 year 6 months in certain cases')

filing.obligation: QDMTT return and payment (国内最低課税額に対する法人税), only if there is a taxable amount
filing.value: Return and payment within 1 year 3 months from the day after FYE ('1 year 6 months in certain cases')

filing.obligation: UTPR return and payment (国際最低課税残余額に対する法人税), only if there is a taxable amount
filing.value: Return and payment within 1 year 3 months from the day after FYE ('1 year 6 months in certain cases')

registration.value: No separate Pillar Two registration identified. Filings go through e-Tax's 'Multinational Enterprise Information Reporting Corner', which requires a one-off e-Tax setup (user ID, preparation setup).
registration.note: Absence of a registration step is an inference from the NTA procedure pages reviewed. Confirm with an adviser.

safeHarbours.value: FY2026 reform: Side-by-Side exemption (group IIR top-up set to zero where the UPE jurisdiction is designated by the Finance Minister) for FYs beginning on or after 1 Jan 2026. Transitional CbCR safe harbour extended by one year to 31 Dec 2027, with the same change for the QDMTT. A UTPR exemption for the UPE jurisdiction portion where designated.

appliesToIir.value: Enacted. TCSH for the IIR (国際最低課税額), 2023 amendment law supplementary provisions Art. 14.

appliesToDomestic.value: Enacted. TCSH for the QDMTT (国内最低課税額), 2025 amendment law supplementary provisions Art. 18 (FYs beginning 1 Apr 2026 to 31 Dec 2026, ending by 30 Jun 2028, before the extension).

enactedPeriod.value: Before the FY2026 reform: FYs beginning 1 Apr 2024 to 31 Dec 2026 and ending by 30 Jun 2028 (MOF explanation of the FY2026 reform, p.756ff).

extension.value: Enacted. Act No. 12 of 31 Mar 2026 (所得税法等の一部を改正する法律), in force 1 Apr 2026, extends the TCSH by one year to FYs beginning by end-2027, for both the IIR and the QDMTT.
extension.note: The MOF explanation states the begin limb (by end-2027) only. The end limb (30 Jun 2029) follows the OECD SbS Package and is not quoted from Japanese law.

portal.value: e-Tax – 多国籍企業情報の報告コーナー (GIR as XML/CSV; IIR return 別表二十)

localFeatures.title: Staggered timing: IIR first, QDMTT/UTPR from April 2026
localFeatures.value: The IIR applies from FYs beginning on or after 1 April 2024. The QDMTT and UTPR apply from FYs beginning on or after 1 April 2026. For a calendar-year group, Japan's QDMTT first applies to FY2027 (beginning 1 Jan 2027). For a March year-end group, it first applies to the FY beginning 1 April 2026.
localFeatures.note: The calendar-year and March-year-end illustrations are our arithmetic on the 'beginning on or after 1 April 2026' rule.

localFeatures.title: QDMTT split into national and local tax
localFeatures.value: QDMTT national tax = 75.3% × domestic minimum top-up amount. A local corporation tax at 247/753 of that national tax brings the total to 100% of the top-up amount. The UTPR national rate is 90.7%.

localFeatures.title: Side-by-Side designation (US)
localFeatures.value: Reported: the US is currently the only jurisdiction designated for the SbS exemption (MOF Notice No. 89, 31 March 2026). The exemption does not switch off Japan's QDMTT.
localFeatures.note: Secondary source (Japanese tax firm article). MOF notice text not fetched.

localFeatures.title: Tax-credit special measure
localFeatures.value: From FYs beginning on or after 1 Jan 2026, part of qualifying investment-promotion tax credits can be added to adjusted covered taxes. The cap is generally the greater of 5.5% of eligible payroll and 5.5% of depreciation on eligible tangible assets.

localFeatures.title: High statutory rate
localFeatures.value: With a combined effective rate of about 29.74%–30.64%, Japanese entities are less likely to have QDMTT exposure, but incentives and GloBE adjustments can still lower the GloBE ETR.
localFeatures.note: The rates are sourced. The exposure comment is our qualitative inference.
